name: Game1K
description: Game1K is widely known online as one of MultiCraft's top players. Starting in 2021, he has actively contributed to the PvP community. He is also the creator of the original tier list system.

name: TimmyLoal
description: TimmyLoal is a famous MultiCraft PvPer who climbed the leaderboards with his impressive skill in both Emerald and Dragonhide KB. However, he retired all of his tiers and quit MultiCraft in late 2025.

name: ioking
description: ioking brought hundreds of players together with his SMP series; Insane Survival (IS). He helped reshape PvP from 2020-2023 and put many players into the spotlight and to reach high rankings on PvP leaderboards from his server and the impact it made on the community.

name: IAMABID
description: Created DvR: the biggest PvP server series in history. He reshaped PvP, and inspired modern-day PvP servers. Reforming Diamond Kit to what it is today, and inspiring all PvPs worldwide.

name: SANDESH
description: The official creator of RvM (Ronaldo vs Messi). He made one of the most viral servers of all time, so viral his server was used in a Multicraft Advertisement. Reshaping PvP and reviving the community.
